entries.german: Sigmund schenkt dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg die Barg Veliš, die Burg Brada, die Städte Jičin, Bydzov u. Veselé, die Burg Lipnic, die. nach dem Tode des Čenek v. Wartenberg heimgefallen sind. KU?
entries.english: Sigmund grants Ulrich von Rosenberg the castle of Veliš, the castle of Brada, the towns of Jičín, Nový Bydžov, and Veselá, and the castle of Lipnice, which had reverted to him after the death of Čeněk von Wartenberg. Royal confirmation?
